outcome: Maternal outcomes (e.g., renal infection, pulmonary edema, severe anemia, ICU admissions)
Fetal outcomes (e.g., premature births, cesarean deliveries, neonatal death, respiratory tract syndrome, asphyxia, growth retardation)
finding: Poor economic and educational levels are significantly associated with preeclampsia, and a high rate of maternal and neonatal morbidity with neonatal mortality was observed.
mod_finding: A majority of preeclamptic patients had cesarean deliveries (63.4%).
